Build, Test, Fix

Robotics Workshops for Schools in Indore

Builds Your Mind runs practical robotics workshops for schools in Indore and across Madhya Pradesh. Students assemble a robot, test it, and then work out why it does what it does.

This is robotics education for schools in Indore built around doing: every group finishes the session with something they have made and tested themselves. For a robotics workshop in Indore, tell us the class group and the date you have in mind.

What Students Build

Workshop Format

A robotics workshop for schools works best as a hands-on session with small groups and a clear task.

Short introduction to the parts and what they do

Group build with support from our trainers

Testing and fixing, repeated until it works

FAQs

The questions schools ask us most often before booking.

Which class groups can take part?

Primary, middle and senior groups, with the build and the task matched to the age of the students.

Do students need to know robotics already?

No. Every build starts from the parts and what they do, so the session works for beginners.

Can you run robotics training for schools across several sessions?

Yes. A one-time workshop is the usual starting point, and schools often continue with a set of sessions or a full programme.

Do you run workshops outside Indore?

Our work covers Indore and Madhya Pradesh. Tell us your city and dates on the enquiry page and we will confirm what we can plan.

How do we enquire?

Share your institution details on the enquiry page. A programme advisor will get back to you to plan the workshop.
